_README: Copy to hosts.json and edit. Restart the relay to apply.
mac         REQUIRED. The WIRED NIC's MAC. Using the Wi-Fi or a virtual
adapter's MAC is the single most common setup mistake - the
panel looks fine and simply never wakes anything.
ip          LAN IP. Also used to derive the /24 directed broadcast.
probe_port  A TCP port open when the machine is up, used for the liveness
dot. USE 22 - setup-host.ps1 opens it across all firewall
profiles, so it is reliable. Do NOT default to 445: Windows 11
puts new networks on the Public profile, which blocks File and
Printer Sharing, so 445 is CLOSED on a fresh install and the
panel would show the machine permanently offline. Verified on a
clean Win11 25H2. NOT ping either - ICMP needs raw sockets
(root) inside a container.
ssh_user    Omit to get wake + online/offline only, no stats or commands.
collector   Absolute path to the telemetry script ON that machine.
USE FORWARD SLASHES even on Windows - PowerShell accepts them,
and a single backslash is an invalid JSON escape that rejects
the whole file. The relay then starts with zero hosts and a
'not valid JSON' line in its log.
os          'windows' or 'linux'. Selects sleep/reboot/shutdown syntax.
wol_verified  Leave false until you have ACTUALLY woken the machine from a
full shutdown. While false the relay refuses shutdown with a
403, so a mis-tap cannot strand a machine you'd have to walk to.
